root_cause: Original SQL #116 dispatcher counted only today's new public-domain source actions (cap eight) plus pending research_enrichment actions in suggested/prepared/waiting. Existing public-domain source actions are status done with a separately scheduled public_email_next_attempt_at; when today's cap is already eight and no other research is pending, dispatcher returns NO_DUE_ORIGINAL_SOURCE_RESEARCH despite due source actions. Existing Edge is able to retry older actions, but never called in this state.
prevention_rule: Original #116 dispatch predicate is true when pending original research OR bounded new first-party discovery OR any valid due existing public-domain research action with source_checked=false. Never mask due retries behind full daily new-action cap. Reuse same original Edge/identity/Brain; preserve initial record and source-revision, provider/candidate/consumer/send gates.
outcome: Original dispatch fix prepared; no new contact, consumer ACK, actual source retry or send claimed
